explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain precisely why the objective rises from 32.43589743589744 to 35.0 by tracing the new logic from the business document’s Feed 4/Feed 5 incompatibility to the exact code additions `y4`, `y5`, and `M = 100000`, and then to the mathematical constraints in `src/formulation.tex`. Using the CSV columns `Protein_g`, `Minerals_g`, `Vitamins_mg`, and `Price_Y_per_kg` plus the requirement parameters `min_protein_requirement = 700`, `min_minerals_requirement = 30`, and `min_vitamins_requirement = 100`, identify which original constraints were binding and their dual values, what their business shadow-price meaning was, and why those LP marginal values cannot be linearly extrapolated to predict the revised MIP optimum after enforcing `y4 + y5 <= 1`. Your answer must name the exact revised active solution variables and quantify the cost increase with the specific feed amounts and constraint references.
